text:
liang: heads up — while testing the Go sample app I noticed the stream drops after ~60s when the phone switches from wifi->cell. repro is pretty small.
liang: server is emitting heartbeats as blank lines (CRLF) between events; the Go SDK parser treats an empty event as EOF and closes the connection.
sam: huh, Node SDK tolerates empty lines and keeps the connection alive?
sam: we've got parity holes across SDKs again :/
maya: can you paste a tiny server snippet and the client logs?
liang: sure — server side is basically this minimal SSE:```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream


event: update
data: {"pos":1}



event: update
data: {"pos":2}

```
liang: client log shows: `sse: received empty chunk -> closing stream` then reconnect; after reconnect it gets duplicate final token and the app misinterprets final message.
isaac: that sounds like the Go parser's state machine treats a blank read as stream termination, which is brittle across mobile network transitions with MTU/fragment differences.
maya: proposed fix: change parser to treat consecutive CRLFs as heartbeats and not EOF; also add a small jittered heartbeat timeout config (default 90s instead of 60) for mobile sample apps.
maya: quick patch idea: on empty line, emit noop event rather than close. I'll sketch a test.
liang: test idea: run the sampleapp on a device, proxy through a tool that inserts random extra CRLF between events to simulate flaky networks.
sam: can we also verify Node and Python SDKs don't regress? maybe add a fuzzer for `\r\n` variations.
isaac: agree. Add unit tests for: empty event, multiple blank lines, `\r` only, `\n` only, and large chunk splits mid-line.
ci-bot: created ticket INF-1428 and a draft branch: go-sdk/ignore-empty-heartbeat. PR link: https://git.redwood/internal/pr/3456
liang: nice, I'll try the draft branch on the sampleapp later today and report metrics (disconnects/min).
maya: also note onboarding doc for Go sample should mention `SDK_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT` env var and mobile note about network transitions. small docs update would save people a lot of debugging time.
sam: ack — i'll add a short paragraph in devex/sdks.md and link the repro proxy script.
liang: thanks all. if the patch looks good we should backport to the dedicated runtime client used in Private.
isaac: agreed — low-risk change but high DX impact.
liang: tl;dr: Go SDK was closing on blank heartbeat lines; patch to treat blank lines as heartbeats and add heartbeat timeout config.
maya: :+1:
ci-bot: INF-1428 assigned to maya, liang. ETA: 2d
liang: ping me if you want me to run more repros on a matrix of devices.
